title: Routing rules: what is a standard, what is a project rule, what is a vendor behaviour (for defaults that must be NAMED, AF-31)

rows.rule: Elbows are inserted at direction changes, tees / olets at branches; the compass ticks equal the fitting angles of the spec; a tolerance angle lets e.g. a 91 deg turn take a 90 deg elbow
Branch table in the spec: header size x branch size -> fitting legend (tee, reducing tee, olet...)
rows.use: FR-RTE-08; the table itself is spec data (01 PSC)

rows.rule: Mating flange, gasket and bolt set are added automatically at flanged connections; failure when a matching gasket / bolt is missing in the spec or no connection rule exists for the end-type pair (e.g. FL and SO)
Branch = head + tail + components; head/tail reference the nozzle (HREF / TREF, CREF on the nozzle); components have arrive / leave p-points; tube between components is implied
rows.grade: A (AVEVA reference manual extracts, several pages)

rows.rule: Pipe features: straight, turn, branch, end, run change, split, along-leg component; parts are selected from the pipe specification of the run
Minimum distance between adjacent circumferential butt welds: none in ASME B31.3; BS 2633 / BS 4515 'no closer than 4 x nominal thickness whenever possible'; many company specs 50 mm or 2T
rows.use: project rule with a NAMED default minWeldSpacing = max(4 t, 50 mm) flagged `source: project default`, never claimed as code

rows.rule: Sloped piping: slope as rise/run or percent; Autodesk example 1/4 in per ft (2.083 %)
Valve operability: MSS SP-91 operator = ~670 N (150 lbf) on a 300 mm lever; handwheel heights are project rules (no public code value found)
rows.use: handwheel height limit is an explicit param or a project table; no built-in number

rows.rule: Validation of disconnected ports and property mismatches as named error types (Plant 3D)
